body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Paris, France. It starts at domaine de la fortelle.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore the world of wild animals with over 600 species to see on a visit that lasts around 5 hours.
>
> Watch various animal feedings with commentary, enjoy a 4D animated film, and hop on the Trans'félins train for a tour of the Lumigny Safari reserve.
>
> Visit the educational farm and let children play in the playground.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €29.88. It was rated 4.4 out of 5 from 118 ratings and 57 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
